The '''Crowd Control Stormtrooper''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] variant often deployed in areas with high criminal activity, where they specialized in suppressing crowds and quelling uprisings. Small [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of these [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] could easily handle mobs of fifty or more, due to their crowd control specific equipment.<ref name="POTF" />

Each stormtrooper was equipped with a [[crowd control thruster pack]], on which was mounted a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster]] module, a [[capture claw]], and a [[supercharged taser]]. These highly maneuverable thruster packs enabled the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to fly at speeds up to 200 km per hour. However, the vehicles were also relatively quiet, which led to their occasional use by the [[Imperial Espionage Division]]. These stormtroopers originated from [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]].<ref name="POTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crowd Control Stormtrooper was created by [[Hasbro]] in [[1996]], as an action figure in the second [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Power of the Force'']] toy line.<ref name="TAFA">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref>
